[RLOW.7.1.1] Intra-tier fact assertion (same tier's working
memory). An `emit` action compiles to a terminal action of
kind `ACTION_ASSERT` ([RDSC.4a.8]) carrying the target schema,
one slot assignment per slot kwarg the action gives, and one
`null` assignment per nullable slot it omits ([LGRA.13.11]). A
`retain:` is the fact's TTL override ([LDTL.4.1]), not a slot
assignment. The runtime asserts the fact via the dispatcher
([IDSP.3]).
